reason: These are paper table analyses, not arbitrary p columns. Current descriptive-only outputs remain valid but should not be labelled complete Table1/S2-S5 candidate analytical coverage until tests are included or specifically nonestimable. Supplemental four-group ranks can use the same small testing function.

frozen_extension.tables: Table1 (frailty binary groups), S2-S5 (each respective four marker quartiles)
frozen_extension.rows: Freeze source-aligned variable row manifest from existing descriptive table schema before any new test results; one test per variable, not one test per category level. Document absent source fields explicitly. Missingness/count-only rows receive no invented test.
frozen_extension.continuous: survey::svyranktest(y~group, design, test='wilcoxon'); same rank-score method for two or four groups. Four-group implementation is documented k-sample rank test, also named KruskalWallis. Not an automatic test solely of medians, and not survey-weighted mean Wald.
frozen_extension.categorical: survey::svychisq(~variable+group, design, statistic='F') second-order Rao-Scott F. Preserve p/statistic/df/method and warnings.
frozen_extension.domain: Use frozen primary table reference cohort and fixed marker cuts. For each row subset existing all-age parent design to the eligible cohort with nonmissing row variable/group; do not rebuild survey design in subsets. Record row N/group N/missing N/design df.
frozen_extension.multiplicity: Separate family for each of five tables. Raw p plus Holm over full planned test-row count, retaining unavailable rows in family denominator. These adjusted p values are analyst additions; no total experiment-wide control claimed. No pairwise posthoc tests or normality-selected method changes.
frozen_extension.self_defined_group_rows: Keep any source-required own-marker versus own-marker-quartile or FI versus FI-derived binary comparison visibly structurally coupled. Such p values cannot validate an independent association. If structurally degenerate/unestimable, retain named row with NA/reason; do not silently remove it or use it as a discovery.
frozen_extension.failure: Absent group levels, constant variable, rank/singular covariance/invalid df yield NA with exact reason. No category merging or alternative method selected after results.
frozen_extension.implementation_note: svyranktest returns different statistic/parameter placement for >2 groups; extract via names/method and retain original named objects, not a presumed universal scalar layout.

scope_limit: Candidate source-aligned tests; weighting, cohort and variable definitions remain declared candidate, not exact author reproduction. Existing no-p-column freeze is superseded solely for these documented source table tests. This is a post-result plan extension without new test-result inspection.
final_coverage_language: Descriptive table rows + source-required group comparisons implemented or individually nonestimable; unreported author details unresolved. Do not call omitted p analyses complete merely because descriptive summaries exist.
